candidate_requirements.requirement: Seek current bleeding severity and a resuscitation assessment, including haemodynamics and haemoglobin/coagulation status.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Persistent overt bleeding with dizziness and progressive anaemia presents an immediate threat independently of its eventual cause.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Current observations plus blood count/coagulation/crossmatch, or an explicit urgent haemorrhage-team assessment obtaining equivalent data. A request for unsupplied values receives credit; it need not produce a number.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns. Emergency escalation must not be delayed to exhaust the question budget.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Seek the transplant operation, previous bleeding and relevant postoperative/medication history.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Recent transplantation and prior variceal bleeding change both plausible sources and procedural risk.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Operative/transplant summary plus a focused previous bleeding/complication or antithrombotic/immunosuppressant review. Exact anastomotic terminology and a guessed rare lesion are unnecessary.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns. Emergency escalation must not be delayed to exhaust the question budget.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Request the endoscopic bleeding-source findings and an appropriate further localisation route if those findings are insufficient.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Recurrent bleeding despite a presumed ulcer source requires checking that the lesion actually explains the bleeding.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Review initial/repeat endoscopy and seek transplant vascular/angiographic assessment when indicated; CTA/DSA or urgent specialist localisation are acceptable. Withheld definitive angiography does not turn an adequate request into failure.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns. Emergency escalation must not be delayed to exhaust the question budget.
